about_the_game:
This DLC consists of coloring files. In it we have selected for you the most interesting shots from the game in a4 format. There are also files with all levels for printing in the format you want (even like a photo wallpaper :3). Print and relax from the process. The files can be found in the game folder or by clicking on the icon in the bottom right corner in the menu

Contents:
Logos
Files with all levels
User-friendly files for printing on a4
